beats.event: Father and son cross devastated post-cataclysm landscape
Reassures the boy they are good guys 'carrying the fire'
A marauder seizes the boy; father shoots him dead
Discover a cellar of people kept for cannibalism
Find a stocked bunker; rest and regain strength
Boy insists they share food with an elderly stranger
Come upon an abandoned campsite with a roasted infant
Near starvation, they reach the coast
Locate a drifting boat and salvage supplies
A thief steals their cart on the beach
Father strips the thief at gunpoint to reclaim their goods
Archer shoots father in the leg; he kills attacker with flare
Father's health collapses; he accepts he is dying
Father dies; boy stays beside the body three days
A man with a shotgun claims to be good and takes the boy
